knownIssues.symptom: Audio crackles in the main hub on an M5 MacBook Air (highball#187, macOS 26.4.1, Highball 0.9.33, DXVK).
knownIssues.cause: not established. Setting the Mac's output to 48 kHz changed nothing, so it is not the sample-rate conversion; the same game is clean on the reporter's Steam Deck, which points at the Mac side. Next suspect is CPU starvation of Wine's audio in the hub on an Air.
